---
name: Taskmaster work item
about: Define one event-driven GroundPulse work item with evidence and human-review boundaries.
title: "[GP-XXX] "
labels: "track:taskmaster"
assignees: ""
---

## Objective

Describe the smallest safe outcome. Do not claim a source, GCP service, or live integration exists unless this issue implements and verifies it.

## Trigger

What starts this work item? Examples: a structured research request, an approved source-freshness event, or an authorized partner event.

## Allowed routing and tools

List the workers, approved adapters, storage locations, and services that may be called. State the source-policy or authorization condition for each.

## Expected artifact

State the output: run-state update, snapshot manifest, claim-ledger entry, research package, or a human-review task.

## Human review boundary

What conditions block autonomous release and require a visible gap or explicit review?

## Acceptance evidence

List schemas, fixtures, tests, screenshots, artifact checksums, or audit records required to close the issue.

## Non-claims

State what this work item does **not** prove or operate.
